description: Writes alignments given by their block coordinates (see write_coordinate_alignment for the JSON object) as a UCSC binary file, byte for byte as Biopython 1.88 Bio.Align.write does, and returns the bytes as base64: bigbed (BED3 - BED12 plus custom autoSQL fields, B+ tree of the chromosomes, R-tree, zoom levels, optional extra string indices), bigmaf (the MAF block of every alignment as an lstring field of the reference chromosome; the first row is named reference.chromosome) and bigpsl (BED12 + the 13 PSL fields: match counts from the residues, other-chromosome fields of the query, oCDS from the CDS feature of the query, oSequence, seqType from the molecule_type annotation; every alignment needs attrs.annotations). The data blocks are zlib-compressed (the compressed bytes depend on the zlib build: with compress = true the .NET deflate stream is used, which Biopython's zlib bytes need not equal; the structure, offsets and decompressed blocks are equal). VERIFICATION: with the compressed blocks of Biopython's own zlib fed back, 216 bigbed, 231 bigmaf and 328 bigpsl committed files equal byte for byte (scripts/alignment/generate_biopython_coord_oracle.py).

alignmentsJson.description: The alignments, each a JSON object (target first; for bigmaf all rows of the MAF block).

targetsJson.description: The chromosomes in the order of the alignments, as a JSON array of {"id": "chr1", "length": 1000} objects (bigmaf: the first id is reference.chromosome).

bedN.description: bigbed: number of BED columns, 3 to 12.

compress.description: Compress the data blocks with zlib.

itemsPerSlot.description: bigbed: number of items per data block.

blockSize.description: bigbed: number of items per R-tree / B+ tree node.

extraIndex.description: bigbed: names of extra string columns to index.

declarationJson.description: bigbed: a custom autoSQL declaration as JSON {"name", "comment", "fields": [[type, name, comment], ...]} (the BED columns first); the extra fields are read from attrs.annotations.

cds.description: bigpsl: write the CDS feature of the query in NCBI style.

mask.description: bigpsl: null, 'lower' or 'upper': repeat-masked target residues are counted as repMatch.

wildcard.description: bigpsl: the code of the wildcard letter counted in nCount (78 = N); null counts nothing, as Biopython's default string 'N' never equals a byte.

base64.description: The bytes of the file, base64.

errors.message: alignmentsJson or targetsJson is null / not JSON
Unknown binary format (supported: bigbed, bigmaf, bigpsl)
Biopython refuses the alignments (for example bedN outside 3 - 12, a chromStart after chromEnd, a missing annotation field)
